movie.title: Inception
movie.outline: A thief who steals corporate secrets through dream-sharing technology is given the inverse task of planting an idea into the mind of a C.E.O.
movie.plot: Dom Cobb is a skilled thief, the absolute best in the dangerous art of extraction: stealing valuable secrets from deep within the subconscious during the dream state. Cobb's rare ability has made him a coveted player in the treacherous world of corporate espionage, but it has also made him an international fugitive and cost him everything he has ever loved. Now Cobb is being offered a chance at redemption. One last job could give him his life back but only if he can accomplish the impossible — inception: planting an idea in someone's mind. If he succeeds, it will be the perfect crime. But no amount of careful planning or expertise can prepare the team for the dangerous enemy that seems to predict their every move.
movie.tagline: Your mind is the scene of the crime.
movie.setOverview: Films exploring the concept of dream infiltration and shared dreaming technology.
movie.award: Academy Award for Best Sound Editing
Academy Award for Best Sound Mixing
Academy Award for Best Visual Effects
movie.parentalGuide: Contains sequences of violence and action throughout. Some thematic elements.

actor.name: Leonardo DiCaprio
actor.bio: Leonardo Wilhelm DiCaprio is an American actor and film producer known for his work in biopics and period films.

actor.name: Joseph Gordon-Levitt
actor.bio: Joseph Leonard Gordon-Levitt is an American actor and filmmaker known for his roles in 500 Days of Summer and The Dark Knight Rises.

actor.name: Elliot Page
actor.bio: Elliot Page is a Canadian actor and producer known for Juno, X-Men: Days of Future Past, and The Umbrella Academy.

actor.name: Tom Hardy
actor.bio: Edward Thomas Hardy is an English actor and producer known for The Dark Knight Rises, Mad Max: Fury Road, and Venom.

director.name: Christopher Nolan
director.bio: Christopher Edward Nolan is a British-American film director, producer, and screenwriter known for The Dark Knight Trilogy, Inception, and Oppenheimer.

writer.name: Christopher Nolan
writer.bio: Christopher Edward Nolan is a British-American film director, producer, and screenwriter known for The Dark Knight Trilogy, Inception, and Oppenheimer.

composer.name: Hans Zimmer
composer.bio: Hans Florian Zimmer is a German-born film score composer and record producer known for Inception, Interstellar, and Dune.

producers.name: Emma Thomas
producers.bio: Emma Thomas is a British film producer and the co-founder of Syncopy, known for producing many of Christopher Nolan's films.
